evidence.quoted_text:
if publication.get('pr_create_pending'):
                raise ValueError('previous PR creation outcome unknown; reconcile existing PR before retry')
evidence.reason: The code sets pr_create_pending and persists it before invoking gh pr create (lines 675-678). On a retry, the caller only adopts an already-existing PR by head; if none exists, finalize_publication reaches this guard and raises every time, leaving the publication in a publish_failed state with no automatic way to clear the pending flag. That is a concrete crash-recovery defect, not merely a request to enlarge scope.
